title: Sefer Chayei HaNefesh, print edition text (Hebrew)
author: Abraham Abulafia
description: Sefer Chayei HaNefesh (The Book of the Life of the Soul) by Abraham Abulafia (1240-c. 1291), the founder of 'prophetic' or 'ecstatic' Kabbalah, here in a Hebrew printed edition text. Abulafia, born in Saragossa, travelled widely, sought an audience with Pope Nicholas III and developed meditative techniques of letter combination (tzeruf), breathing and recitation of divine names intended to lead the practitioner to prophetic experience and union with the Active Intellect. This work is his commentary on the secrets of Maimonides' Guide of the Perplexed, read as an esoteric document of prophecy and the soul's intellectual perfection, interpreting philosophical ideas through the mysteries of the divine names and letters. It is an important source for the fusion of Maimonidean philosophy and Kabbalah and for Abulafia's mystical psychology. A separate manuscript-based text of the same work is also in the library.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/chayeihanefesh).
